links.evidence: We currently source approximately 50% of our wafer requirements annually from third-party wafer fabrication foundries, primarily Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC).
We are also a party to a Wafer Supply Agreement (WSA) with GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (GF), with respect to wafer purchases at the 12 nm and 14 nm technology nodes.
In exchange, we will receive single digit royalties on all biosimilar products developed and commercialized by Samsung Bioepis.
Ingram Micro Inc. ("Ingram Micro"), our second largest distributor, accounted for 10 % , 11 % , 8 % of Autodesk's total net revenue for fiscal years ended January 31, 2020 , 2019 , and 2018 .
Target Corporation accounted for approximately 11% of our total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2017 .
We are delivering the Flyer 60 and Flyer 72 to U.S. Special Operations Command for the Internally Transportable Vehicle (ITV) and Ground Mobility Vehicle (GMV) programs.
